deviations: Native intake answers were inferred from the frozen PRD and recorded because the isolated experiment could not pause for a user response.

setup-opendesign, run-opendesign and verifier subagents could not be independently derived; local setup/server and reproducible real-browser QA were used and not misrepresented as clean-context verification.
Camera hardware is simulated with a supplied PRD image for deterministic offline playback.
The supplied toy-camera image and a complete supplied UI screenshot are reused as success-path content, producing nested-interface artifacts that reduce fidelity.
Some screenshots were captured during the 240ms entry transition and therefore show partially transparent intermediate frames.
The agreement indicator is not toggleable, album thumbnails have no selected state, and completing a successful review ends with a toast rather than a durable destination.
Camera permission denial, empty album, network failure and review timeout states are not implemented.

The QA replay script does not start its own HTTP server; structured raw evidence covers the ten contracted failure-path tasks but not the success branch or second viewport, which are evidenced by screenshots and stdout only.

One older-cell vendor file was mistakenly read during setup, then replaced with a pinned public package download; all final vendor hashes were independently matched against fresh official-source downloads and recorded without sensitive information.
